look: Sathya's B&W collage reel series (copied from their reference video): white paper texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spotlight / soft light; their halftone sticker cut-outs pinned with soft drop shadows; AI for Real Life brand accents: pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD (their logo); pro camera rig with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins, whip-ins/outs, match-cut zooms and roll transitions; AI for Real Life logo end card; camera travels through a tall world (pushes, tilts, whips with motion blur), Morven kicker over a huge Allenoire headline with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes and stamps, hand-drawn pink marks, torn-paper B&W stock clips, glitch blocks at cuts. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, every beat timed to Sathya's voice-over (Reel_06 voice-over, 91.7 s), text kept inside the Reels safe zone. Sathya’s own halftone portrait of Sam Altman as a sticker. Logo slots: plain cream cards that hold perfectly still in the foreground, for Sathya to lay official logos over in their editor.

scenes.name: Shredded share
scenes.desc: Frame 0 mid-swing: a hand stamps a pink 0% on a share certificate carrying Sam Altman's portrait; it feeds into a shredder; an empty pocket, 0% equity, OpenAI logo slot.

scenes.name: The internal test
scenes.desc: ChatGPT logo slot over an old computer, Internally stamp; 95% counts up while 19 of 20 users drop away; a rocket launches anyway.
2015 slams in; starting an AGI lab; Low status stamp; three laughing doubters; no one took it seriously.

scenes.name: The parrot
scenes.desc: Critics argued: a parrot squawks two speech bubbles: cannot create new knowledge, only repeat training data.

scenes.name: The pattern
scenes.desc: Altman's portrait over cities, careers and computers, then a super-linear curve draws: super-linear returns.

scenes.name: The bet
scenes.desc: Aug 2022, GPT-4 finished; all the chips pushed in, server rack, massive compute; data-centre clip with before the world knew what GPT-4 could do.

scenes.name: 5% who loved it
scenes.desc: Retention gauge needle drops to a dismal 5%; launched anyway; 100 dots, five turn pink; didn’t just like it; an anatomical heart, loved it.

scenes.name: The blueprint
scenes.desc: Build something extraordinary: a blueprint unrolls, Altman's blueprint, 3 things.

scenes.name: Rule 1
scenes.desc: Trade: a brass scale swings from short-term low status to long-term high status.

scenes.name: Rule 2
scenes.desc: Focus on asking the right questions: a raised hand and a big pink question mark; not just answers.

scenes.name: Rule 3
scenes.desc: Listen to less generic advice: a megaphone gets a pink X; compound non-obvious skills every year: bars climb.

scenes.name: The goal
scenes.desc: Not just chatbots: AI machines that discover new science, math and medicine; a rocket lifts off past Humanity.

scenes.name: Optimist or pessimist
scenes.desc: Comedy and tragedy masks swing in: optimistic or pessimistic about AI’s impact? Drop your thoughts, save this.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
